settings.eyebrow: Boulder & Grit Climbing Gym · 40+ ft of wall · All levels welcome
settings.headline:
Strong hands,
calmer head.
settings.copy: Boulder & Grit is a modern climbing gym built for people who climb for the problem, not the podium — forty feet of textured bouldering wall, a toprope arena, and a community that spots each other on the hard moves. You bring the stubbornness; we bring the chalk, the crash pads, and the coaching.

trust_list.text: 40+ feet of bouldering wall, reset weekly
Toprope and lead walls, all auto-belay ready
First-timer sessions and kids' walls included
Coaching, yoga, and a gear shop under one roof

settings.title: Find your
settings.intro: Whether you're working a V0 on your first day or projecting a V8 at last call, there's a corner of B&G built for the effort you're ready to give.

design.title: Bouldering wall
design.text: Forty feet of textured wall with crash pads below and a fresh set of problems every week — from slab to overhang, graded and color-coded.

design.title: MoonBoard & Kilter
design.text: Two training boards for when you want the same problem as half the planet and a session that reads like a workout, not a wander.

build.title: Toprope arena
build.text: Auto-belays and partner lines from 30 to 55 feet, with routes that reward both endurance and technique. Walk up, clip in, climb.

build.title: Lead wall
build.text: A dedicated lead arena with draws already hung and a friendly staff that will belay-check you before you take the whip.

launch.title: First-climb session
launch.text: A 90-minute coached intro that covers safety, footwork, and the confidence to finish your first problem. Gear rental included.

launch.title: Coaching & camps
launch.text: Small-group technique coaching, kids' after-school camps, and a women's-plus and trans night every week, run by climbers who teach.

settings.title: Climbing is a
settings.intro: Anyone can bolt up a wall. B&G exists to give you a wall worth bolting up — one where the holds stay interesting, the safety is second nature, and the person on the mat beside you is pulling for you.

features.title: Walls that change
features.text: Every Monday the setters rebuild a full section of the bouldering wall. There's always a problem you haven't figured out yet.

features.title: Safety as a habit
features.text: Staffed belay checks, daily equipment inspection, and pads deep enough that a fall is a non-event, not a negotiation.

features.title: Coaching, not gatekeeping
features.text: Our coaches climb with you. Whether it's your first V0 or your first lead fall, someone will talk you through the beta and the fear.

features.title: A community that spots
features.text: Weekly social boulders, a lending-chalk bin, and a crew that celebrates your send as loudly as their own.

features.title: Everything you need
features.text: A gear shop with rentals, a yoga studio, showers, and a cafe with better coffee than you expect from a climbing gym.

features.title: Your pace, your day
features.text: Open 7am to 11pm, with quiet weekday mornings for the focused and late nights for the after-work senders.

settings.title: From the door
settings.intro: New here? The path from the front desk to your first successful problem is short, friendly, and never embarrassing. Here's how it goes.

steps.title: Check in & waive in
steps.text: A quick sign-in at the desk, a rental-shoe fitting if you need them, and a five-minute chalk-up before you head to the floor.

steps.title: Safety walkthrough
steps.text: A staff member walks you through the zones, the crash-pad rules, and how to fall properly — under two minutes, and you'll feel it.

steps.title: Try your first problem
steps.text: Pick a V0 in the beginner bay. The holds match the color, the staff points, and the people on the mats cheer. Nobody watches, everybody helps.

steps.title: Keep the streak going
steps.text: Finish one and you'll want three. Your pass gets you all-day access, so grab a coffee, rest your forearms, and get back on the wall.

settings.note: Boulder & Grit is an all-levels gym: beginners are the majority, and the only bad climb is the one you didn't try. Every session is covered by our gear, our pads, and our coaches.

settings.title: Next set
settings.expired_text: This week's wall reset is up — come see the new problems before the setters tear them down again on Monday.

settings.title: Why they keep
settings.intro: We asked members why B&G is their wall. They said: the holds, the people, and the feeling of finishing something hard. Here's a few of their answers.

reviews.quote: I started climbing at 41 with zero upper-body strength and a genuine fear of heights. Eighteen months later I've sent my first V4 and I honestly don't recognize the person I was. The coaches here climb WITH you, never at you.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.quote: The Monday resets are my favorite part. I walk in, scan the new wall, and there's always a problem I didn't know I could do until I tried it. Best gym culture in the city.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: My kids begged to come after school. Now it's the highlight of their week and mine — the staff are patient, the kids' wall is actually challenging, and the cafe makes it easy to stay.
reviews.author: Elena R.

settings.title: Come try the
settings.intro: Drop in for a first climb, book a coaching session, or just grab a coffee and watch the wall for a while. Real staff reply within one business day.
